items.html:
Implemented and frozen on Linux:

  • Large thin internal solves use batched GMRES only after proving ||I−A||∞ < 1; otherwise retain LU. Both passes enforce original precision and reuse storage.
  • Preserved singular-system rejection and mutation-safe adjoint snapshots.
  • Verified native adjoint/contraction/fallback tests, 27 Python tests, Clippy and Ruff.

Diagnostic forward results: 2.61×/2.17× faster than upstream for N1024/P1/P8; 239 versus 261 MiB. Recorded AD still retains necessary dense input snapshots; its memory gap remains. Mac and serialized final measurements pending.

Changed smatrix.rs, GMRES visibility in iterative.rs, and test_internal_bands.py. Extension ownership returned to accuracy_papers. No Mac changes, commits or pushes.
